name: anti-tangent-protocol
description: On-demand loader for the anti-tangent-mcp drift-protection protocol. A description-triggered skill that loads only the role-scoped part of the protocol an agent actually needs — keeping the always-loaded footprint to one line, and the on-demand read to roughly half of what a single combined document would cost. Also ships the investigate skill, which turns a reported error or production incident into an approved bug-fix brief, and the test-value and debugging rules under rules/ for review tooling to read.
